title: Emotional Healing Laboratory:  The Workplace
content_raw: [iframe style="border:none" src="//html5-player.libsyn.com/embed/episode/id/34458110/height/100/width//thumbnail/yes/render-playlist/no/theme/custom/tdest_id/2030600/custom-color/87A93A" height="100" width="100%" scrolling="no" allowfullscreen webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen oallowfullscreen msallowfullscreen] Susan Winchester, former chief HR officer, discusses how the workplace can be a laboratory for emotional healing and personal growth. She emphasizes the importance of recognizing how our childhood experiences shape our behavior and relationships in the workplace. Susan shares her own journey of healing and provides practical strategies for managing workplace conflict and setting boundaries. She introduces the concept of 'bumper car moments' as opportunities for growth and transformation. Susan's work aims to help individuals unlock their potential and create healthier, more fulfilling work experiences.
